title: NOT ME, BUT YOU

pages.content:
NOT ME, BUT YOU
The National Service Scheme (NSS) was established on September
24, 1969, with the objective of developing social responsibility and
community service among young people. NSS focuses on various areas,
including education, health, environment, and disaster management. The
scheme organizes community service projects, blood donation camps,
health awareness programs, tree plantations, and cleanliness drives.
Through NSS, volunteers develop social awareness and responsibility,
build leadership and teamwork skills, and foster community engagement
and participation. With a structure that spans national, state, and
institutional levels, NSS provides opportunities for young people to
participate in community service, develop leadership skills, and gain
awareness about social issues and community needs.

KUCET NSS UNITS
nssunitkucet@gmail.com
- Establishment: The KUCET NSS unit was sanctioned in February
2014.
- Objective: To promote social awareness, community service, and skill
development among students.
- Activities: The unit organizes various events, including:
- Blood donation camps
- Health awareness programs
- Tree plantations
- Cleanliness drives
- Volunteer Structure: The unit consists of 2 units (Unit I and Unit II)
with 100 volunteers registered in each unit.
- Programme Officers: Led by Programme Officers, including Dr. D.
Sailaja and M. Soujanya.
- Mission: To foster a sense of social responsibility among students and
encourage community participation.

OBJECTIVES
The main objectives of NSS are:
 Understand the community: Enable students to comprehend the
community they serve.
 Self-understanding: Help students understand themselves in
relation to their community.
 Identify and solve problems: Recognize community needs and
problems and involve students in solutions.
 Develop social responsibility: Foster a sense of social and civic
responsibility.
 Apply knowledge: Utilize knowledge to find practical solutions
for community issues.
 Develop group competence: Acquire skills for group living and
sharing responsibilities.
 Mobilize participation: Gain skills in mobilizing community
involvement.
 Acquire leadership: Develop leadership qualities and a democratic
attitude.
 Meet emergencies: Build capacity to respond to emergencies and
disasters.
 Practice national integration: Promote national integration and
social harmony.

Achievements
 Viksit Bharat youth parliament two of our students went to state
level compilation.
 Third Highest blood samples collected in the Warangal district.
Coordinators Duties
 Program planning
 Volunteer management
 Community engagement
 Project monitoring
 Reporting
 Organizing camps and events
 Promoting social awareness and community service
 Developing project proposals
 Managing NSS funds
 Coordinating with stakeholders
Former coordinators
Dr.Md.Asim Iqbal UNIT - II 17/08/2017 to 19/01/2025
Dr.R.Meghana Rao UNIT - I 17/ 08/2017 to 29/09/2019

Mrs.K.Sumalatha

1. EVENT: “Clean and Green program conducted on campus”
DATE: 08-February-2025.
As part of the collective effort to promote environmental awareness and
sustainability, a comprehensive "Clean and Green" program was successfully
conducted at the KU College of Engineering and Technology (KUCE&T) college
ground. The event witnessed enthusiastic participation from students of all academic
years and branches, alongside the dedicated involvement of both teaching and non-
teaching staff members.
The primary objective of the program was to foster a sense of environmental
responsibility among the college community by engaging in activities that directly
contribute to the cleanliness and beautification of the campus.
The event reflected the institution’s commitment to environmental stewardship and
created a positive impact by inspiring individuals to adopt eco-conscious habits in
their daily lives.

02.EVENT: “Library Books Alignment”
DATE: 22-February-2025.
As part of the National Service Scheme (NSS) initiative, a meaningful and
productive activity was undertaken by the NSS volunteers of the college, focusing on
the alignment and organization of library books. This event aimed to support the
upkeep and efficient management of the college library, which serves as a vital
academic resource for both students and faculty members.
This activity not only contributed to the smooth functioning of the library but also
instilled in the volunteers a deeper sense of discipline, responsibility, and appreciation
for collective service. It was a reflection of the core NSS values—“Not Me, But
You”—fostering a spirit of selfless contribution to the community and institution.
The initiative was well-received by the library staff and academic community,
highlighting the importance of volunteer-driven efforts in maintaining and enhancing
institutional infrastructure.

03. EVENT: “Motivational Visit to Bheemaram Govt High
School”
DATE: 01-March-2025
As part of its continuous efforts to serve the community and support
educational development, the NSS team from our college undertook a heartfelt
outreach program by visiting Bheemaram Government School. The primary objective
of the visit was to motivate and uplift students who are currently preparing for their
SSC (10th class) examinations.
During this meaningful initiative, eight dedicated NSS volunteers engaged in one-on-
one and group interactions with the students, offering words of encouragement,
sharing useful study tips, and instilling confidence in their abilities. The volunteers
spoke about the importance of hard work, time management, and staying positive
during exam preparation. They also shared their own academic experiences and
personal journeys, which served as relatable and inspiring examples for the young
student

04. EVENT: “Mega Blood Donation Camp Organized by NSS
Units of KUCE&T in Collaboration with IRCS”.
DATE: 10-March-2025
The NSS Units of KU College of Engineering & Technology (KUCE&T), in
collaboration with the Indian Red Cross Society, organized a Mega Blood Donation
Camp. The event was inaugurated by KU .
Vice-Chancellor Prof. K. Pratap Reddy, along with
Registrar Prof. V. Ramachandram,
Red Cross Chairman Dr. P. Vijaychander Reddy,
NSS Coordinator Prof. Esam Narayana,
And Principal Dr. N. Ramana.
The camp saw an enthusiastic response, with 190 students registering and 151 units of
blood collected. The event was efficiently managed by NSS volunteers and supported
by medical staff from the Red Cross. The program highlighted the spirit of service
and the vital role of youth in community health efforts.

05. EVENT: “Viksit Bharat Youth Parliament”
DATE: 22-March-2025 | 23-March-2025
Around 120 NSS volunteers from KU College of Engineering & Technology
registered on the My Bharat portal, actively engaging in national youth initiatives.
Among them, 10 volunteers participated in the Viksit Bharat Youth Parliament, held
at the district level in the Department of Commerce, Kakatiya University, from 22nd
to 23rd March 2025.
We are proud to announce that N. Sravya (3rd CSD) and T. Karthik (3rd IT) were
selected to represent the college at the State Level Competitions to be held in
Hyderabad. Their selection is a testament to their outstanding communication,
leadership, and vision for a developed India.

06. EVENT: “Clean and Green" Program by NSS Units at
KUCE&T.
DATE: 28-march-2025.
As part of an NSS activity, Unit-I and Unit-II of KU College of Engineering &
Technology organized a "Clean and Green" program to promote environmental
awareness and campus cleanliness.
The event saw active participation from final-year students of the ECE, EEE, CSE,
and IT departments, who contributed enthusiastically to cleaning and beautifying the
campus. The initiative aimed to instill a sense of environmental responsibility and
teamwork among students while enhancing the college surroundings.
This activity reflected the true spirit of NSS and the commitment of students toward
creating a cleaner, greener future.

07. EVENT: "Clean and Green" Program by NSS Units at
KUCE&T.
DATE: 04-April-2025.
As part of the NSS "Clean and Green" Program, final-year students of KU
College of Engineering and Technology actively participated in a campus cleanliness
and greenery drive.
The students demonstrated great enthusiasm and teamwork, contributing to a cleaner
and more eco-friendly campus environment. Their involvement reflects the values of
responsibility and service upheld by the NSS.

08. EVENT: “Health Awareness Program Conducted on World
Health Day”.
DATE: 07-April-2025.
As part of the observance of World Health Day, KU College of Engineering
and Technology organized a Health Awareness Program at Government High School,
Pegadapally on 07/04/2025.
The initiative aimed to educate school students about the importance of maintaining
good health, personal hygiene, balanced nutrition, and preventive care. The program
included interactive sessions, health tips, and awareness talks to encourage students to
adopt healthy lifestyle practices.
This outreach reflects the institution's commitment to community welfare and health
education.

09. EVENT: “Celebration of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar’s Birth
Anniversary at KUCE&T”.
DATE: 11-April-2025.
NSS Unit I and Unit II of KU College of Engineering & Technology,
Kakatiya University proudly celebrated the birth anniversary of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar,
the principal architect of the Indian Constitution and a champion of social justice.
As part of the celebration, a seminar and quiz competition were organized for
students, highlighting Dr. Ambedkar’s life, contributions, and legacy. The event
served to inspire students and spread awareness about his pivotal role in shaping
modern India.

10. EVENT: NSS "Clean and Green" Activity by Final-Year Civil
Engineering Students”.
DATE: 28-April-2025.
As a part of the NSS "Clean and Green" Program, final-year Civil Engineering
students of KU College of Engineering and Technology actively participated in a
campus cleanliness and beautification drive.
The students showed great enthusiasm and dedication toward promoting
environmental awareness and maintaining a clean, green campus. Their efforts reflect
the NSS spirit of service, responsibility, and community involvement.

11. EVENT: Plantation program on World Environment Day at
K-HUB.
DATE: 05-June-2025.
On the occasion of World Environment Day on 05-06-2025 , Unit I and Unit
II NSS Volunteers of KUCE&T participated in plantation program at K-Hub.This was
inaugurated by Vice-Chancellor of Kakatiya University Prof K.Prathap Reddy.

12. EVENT: Felicitation to NSS Units of KUCE&T by Red Cross
Society.
DATE: 15-June-2025.
On 15-06-2025 the World Blood Donor day, Indian Red cross Society and
Chief guest Registrar of KU Prof V. Ramachandram felicitated the Principal of
KUCE&T Dr.N.Ramana, along with NSS Program officers Dr.D.Sailaja and
M.Soujanya on donating (151) third highest blood samples from KU College of
Engineering and Technology from Warangal district for the academic year 2024-25.

13. EVENT: Quiz on Role of Women in Shaping the New India
conducted by Ministry of Defence and MyGov Congratulate.
DATE: 16-June-2025.
